During the days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''bounty hunter''' was hired by a [[Unidentified crime lord (Sudden Restoration attack)|crime lord]] to attack the [[Carosite]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical ship]], ''[[Sudden Restoration]]'', a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] that provided free medical care to all, regardless of [[Species/Legends|species]] or political affiliation. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] primary target was an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Sudden Restoration patient)|Imperial officer]] who was receiving treatment on the ship. The attack prompted the New Republic to station [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] aboard the ship to prevent future attacks.
